name: Wither and Bloom

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a withered vine twisted into a loop

summary: Reference-only: Chosen creatures in a 10-foot-radius Sphere save Constitution against 3d6 Necrotic, half on success; ordinary plants wither. One chosen creature there may spend one Hit Die, healing its roll + your spellcasting modifier. Each slot above 2 adds 1d6 damage and one available Hit Die; add the modifier only once.
